title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at how the y-values change as $$x$$ increases. Consider which function f(x) could transform $$x$$ to match this pattern.

title: Analyzing Function Behavior
text: Think about the behavior of each function option: linear, quadratic, absolute value, and negative linear. Which one aligns with the pattern in the scatterplot?

title: Choosing the Right Function
text: Which function f(x) would create a linear relationship with the y-values as shown in the scatterplot?
